feature: Sentence-centric translation review with five vertically stacked question cards
behavior: Five full English-and-answer cards for questions 46–50 replace the six review-section navigation tabs.
The selected question presents score/review, reference differences, grammar, vocabulary and complete corrected translation in one continuous panel.
A compact overall score and summary remain above the workspace; global or ambiguous material remains accessible without dropping original Markdown.
Existing bold numbered headings, mixed score/difference/vocabulary tables and final translations are parsed locally without model calls or data migration.

Appeals are scoped to the selected question, previewed before adoption and reversible; exact source offsets, score preservation and reparsing checks prevent changes to other questions or global content.
Raw Markdown, copying, downloading, numbered bulk input and explicit sentence confirmation remain available.
Original eight writing navigation entries, writing theme, translation sidebar collapse and current practice/reference records are preserved.

verification.legacyReview: Read-only validation of the existing legacy 2020 Markdown mapped all five categories to every question; private review text was not committed.

fullSuite.test: tests/archive-consistency.test.mjs:127 analytics returns bound reviewed texts and rewrite links without writing data
fullSuite.note: The translation changes do not modify the writing analytics module. Focused translation checks, typecheck, browser checks and build passed.
